content:
Cross-team engineering leadership weekly staff meeting notes
Date: 2026-03-30
Time: 09:00 - 10:00 PT
Location: Zoom + recorded (link in Slack)
Attendees: Ava Martinez (serving runtime), Devon Chen (applied ML), Priya Nair (release eng), Liam O'Connell (SRE), Sofia Alvarez (product-hosted-api), Marco Ruiz (private deployments, joined 09:20), onboarding: Elena Park (solutions eng)

1) Quick round-robin updates (5m each)
- Serving Runtime (Ava): Work continues on prefix/KV caching prototype. Initial perf numbers: up to 18% token cost reduction for chat workloads with long context; p95 latency unchanged for median seq len. Kernel selection heuristics updated to prefer fused-attn on ampere for 32-token warmup window. Still need to validate multi-tenant isolation tests.
- Applied ML (Devon): Quantization experiments for opt-12b-qat show ~2-3% quality delta on eval-sets so far; memory reduction good. Planning 1 week of expanded evals against customer prompt sets. Working with DE to add new eval harness.
- Release Engineering (Priya): CI flakiness spike earlier this week traced to flaky integration test that stubs KMS in private deployments. Filed JIRA-IR-1421; temporary mitigation is to skip the test in the mainline until fix applied.
- SRE (Liam): Incident postmortem for 2026-03-27 outage is in progress. Root cause points to autoscaler edge-case with burst capacity reconciliation. We've applied a hotfix and throttled some background jobs. Need longer-term fix in autoscaler logic.
- Product / Hosted API (Sofia): Beta for streaming structured output shipped to 5 customers. One beta customer requested stricter latency SLO; working w/ serving runtime for routing policy adjustments.

2) Prior meeting action review (5m)
- Autoscaler tuning (Liam): Hotfix applied; longer-term change in backlog -> action to validate in staging (assigned, see action items).
- Eval harness for quantization (Devon): PR opened (GITHUB-PR-9821) and awaiting review from DE.
- Customer onboarding checklist for Dedicated (Sofia): checklist updated; BrightLens onboarding pushed 1 week due to account provisioning delays.

3) Incident review: 2026-03-27 partial outage (20m)
- Summary: Region us-west-2 experienced degraded throughput for ~45m. Root cause: Autoscaler reconciliation bug when burst-capacity pools cross a threshold during a rolling update. This caused a subset of nodes to be marked unhealthy and evicted requests before fallback triggered. Postmortem link: JIRA-IR-1421.
- Impact: ~3% of total requests in region retried; some high-priority customers saw tail latency spikes. No data loss.
- Immediate fixes taken: Reverted the recent autoscaler optimization change, applied a conservative threshold, and rebalanced pools.
- Long-term mitigations: Add canary for autoscaler change (staged rollout), improve health-check grace logic, and add automated test for burst pool crossing scenario.
- Owners: Priya to lead postmortem doc; Liam to lead autoscaler fix.

4) Feature rollout discussion: prefix/KV caching (20m)
- Status: Prototype running in internal staging. Performance: up to 18% token cost reduction for chat-heavy workloads; token hit-rate depends on prompt patterns.
- Risks: Potential memory overhead under certain workloads; correctness concerns around conversation rewrites and tool-calls; multi-tenant cache cross-talk must be strictly prevented.
- Proposed rollout plan: Canary -> small subset of hosted customers (low-risk) -> Dedicated staging -> Gradual ramp with circuit-breaker to disable caching on detectable anomalies.
- Telemetry needs: per-tenant cache hit/miss, eviction rates, memory per shard, impact on p95/p99 latency. Instrumentation owners: Ava + Marco (private deployments) + Observability team (follow-up ticket).
- Decision: Approved to proceed with controlled canary. Ava to draft rollout runbook and canary criteria by 2026-04-02.

5) Dedicated / Private updates (10m)
- Dedicated autoscaling: New autoscaler tuning in draft; performance improved in synthetic tests but integration with rollout engine still flaky. Liam to validate.
- Private deployment packaging: Marco reports an installer regression for RHEL8 that blocks a customer on-prem test — patch queued for 2026-03-31.
- Security/KMS: Key rotation tests for private deployments completed; minor issue in audit logs discovered and being fixed.

6) Observability & Console (5m)
- New per-route token cost dashboard rolled into console beta. Early feedback: helpful but needs aggregation by prompt family. Product to collect requirements.
- Tracing hooks: small perf overhead; scheduled A/B test to measure impact.

7) Risks & blockers (5m)
- CI flakiness (Priya): Blocks faster turnaround for hotfixes. Action: open postmortem and prioritize flaky test fixes (see action items).
- Customer onboarding delays (Sofia): BrightLens onboarding delayed due to account provisioning and security review. Sofia to coordinate.
- Autoscaler regression risk: blocking for small fraction of customers; need staged rollout for autoscaler changes.

8) Miscellaneous / notes to self
- Reminder: prepare a short update for exec sync on 2026-04-01 re: autoscaler incident and prefix-KV canary plan.
- Link to internal eval sets and prompt bank: CONFLUENCE-Page-Evals/prompt-bank (Devon to confirm access lists)
- Slack links: #infra (thread: Caching-Opt-2026-03), #sre (incident-2026-03-27)

Decisions made:
- Proceed with controlled canary for prefix/KV caching (owner: Ava).
- Revert/hold autoscaler optimization until canary + automated tests in place (owner: Liam).

Next meeting:
- Date: 2026-04-06, 09:00 PT
- Primary focus: canary readiness review, CI flakiness postmortem, Dedicated autoscaler validation

Attachments / Links:
- JIRA-IR-1421 (incident)
- GITHUB-PR-9821 (quantization eval harness)
- CONFLUENCE-Page-ServingRuntime-Performance-Runbook

End of notes
notes_summary: Weekly cross-team leadership notes covering autoscaler incident postmortem, prefix/KV caching canary approval, CI flakiness, Dedicated onboarding delays, and action items assigned.
